description: Configuration for the AI-First Proposal Judge. knowledgePath plus knowledgeFile identify the single authoritative grounding file. Point the *Path values at local folders (which may be synced OneDrive/SharePoint folders). To pull/push artefacts directly from SharePoint Online instead, set sharepoint.enabled = true and fill in the sharepoint.* library folders; the *Path values then act as local cache/staging locations. submissionMode 'folderPerTeam' means each immediate subfolder of submissionsPath is one team whose accepted files form that team's submission; loose files at the root are single-file teams. maxParallelTeams bounds concurrent team evaluations. See docs/AUTOMATION-AND-DISTRIBUTION.md.
